info.title: Family Safety — BEFE Layer-1 (App → Channel BE)
info.description: App-facing BEFE aggregate APIs that land on Channel BE. THREE reads cover the Safety Circle screens: (1) GET /home = Family + members + relations + roles/responders + ACTIVE SERVICES (network) + SIGNALS (fans out to FSC family/get + member/get(all) + device/status/fetch + UCM titles + history count); (2) GET /members/{membershipId} = member services (FSC member/get) + full DEVICE STATUS (FSC device/status/fetch) + check-in status; (3) GET /history = FSC history/fetch. Response carries everything the UI + BEFE requirements need so the app makes one call per screen.
